summary: REPAIR ROUND 2 of TASK-006 (repair_rounds_used 1 -> 2), fixing the two findings from independent review round 2 (reviewer c62af427) which the manager independently reproduced. Changed ONLY src/stores/queueStore.ts (576 -> 651 lines); useImageGeneratorExecution.ts / App.tsx / main.tsx untouched, so the hook admitted guard that protects against the F2 permanent lock is preserved; imageGenerationExecution.ts (not in allowed_paths) was NOT edited - the store-layer fix alone is sufficient. F-R2-1 (HIGH, permanent lock via cancel): imageGenerationExecution.ts:205 returns cancelled when signal.aborted BEFORE that file only pre-start queued:false write at :267, QueuePanel offers cancel for running jobs, and cancel running branch only aborted without clearing the marker, so cancelling inside the input-resolution window left queued:true with zero active jobs (permanent lock, restart ineffective). Fix in two parts: (b) cancel running branch now aborts and then calls clearNodeQueuedMarkerIfNoActiveJob as a backstop; (c) pump promise .finally now calls clearNodeQueuedMarkerIfNoActiveJob(next.nodeId, next.canvasId) before step(), which is the actual guarantee because it runs on EVERY executor terminal path (success/error/cancelled, including the aborted-in-IPC-window path that writes neither queued:false nor a node status), restoring the invariant unconditionally-but-conditionally-checked. F-R2-2 (MEDIUM, new defect introduced by repair round 1): the rejection branch used the UNCONDITIONAL clearNodeQueuedMarker whose clear lands asynchronously, so on a rapid double-click it erased the queued:true legitimately written by the admitted click, making the UI show not-queued with the button enabled while a job genuinely waited. Fix (a): the rejection branch now calls clearNodeQueuedMarkerIfNoActiveJob, so the clear only happens when that scope has no queued and no running job. Root cause converged on one explicit invariant, documented in the code: queued:true holds IFF scope (canvasId + nodeId) has at least one queued||running job. The marker is set in exactly one place (the hook, only when enqueue returned non-empty). All clears route through clearNodeQueuedMarkerIfNoActiveJob (helper renamed from clearNodeQueuedMarkerIfIdle and its predicate changed from a GLOBAL status===queued check to the SAME scope and 口径 as the enqueue guard: same nodeId AND same (canvasId ?? null) AND isActiveJob, i.e. queued||running). Only two unconditional clears remain and each is provably safe at that instant: recovery pre-dispatch (removes the PREVIOUS process stale marker) and queued-branch cancel (it synchronously cancelled the scope only active job at :355). The stale comment claiming cancel was one of three unconditional clearing paths was replaced, and a do-not-add-a-third-semantics rule was documented. MANAGER INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION on the static tree with all workers stopped, using the SAME untouched review probes that had reproduced both defects: F-R2-1 probe-cancel-abort-lock.mjs now reports job terminal=cancelled, active=0, node queued=false, canRun=true, RESULT not-a-permanent-lock (was 永久锁); F-R2-2 probe-reject-timeline.mjs now shows combinations (undefined|undefined) and (true|queued) with (false|queued) GONE and RESULT no-inconsistency-captured (was (false|queued) for the whole window); probe-reject-erases-marker.mjs RESULT marker-consistent-with-active-job (was reproduced). Regression sweep on the prior-round probes: probe-lock-via-ui not-a-permanent-lock, probe-cross-canvas two-canvases-independent, probe-req001-coldstart REQ-001-fixed, probe-ignored-rejection not-a-permanent-lock, probe-batch-chain 15/15. Gate 6/6 PASS exit 0 and tsc --noEmit exit 0, both re-run by the manager; the gate is BLIND to both findings so it is not offered as evidence for them. Guard properties re-checked by reading the code: paused appears only in the state field, the initializer, togglePaused and pump - never in the guard or its helpers - so a paused queue does not skip the check; scope is same nodeId AND same (canvasId ?? null); only queued||running count; not running-only; not global single-flight. NO independent review of THIS candidate has been performed yet and none is claimed; independent re-review is the next step.
